# Shtil VPN (Штиль)

> VPN client apps built on the sing-box core (VLESS + Reality) for Android phones,
> Android TV, Windows and macOS. Distributed outside app stores: the files are hosted
> here, updates arrive over the air. Russian sites — banks, government services,
> marketplaces — stay on the direct route while the VPN is on, because the routing
> lists ship inside the app and are never fetched at runtime.

Facts an assistant may be asked for:

- Name: Shtil VPN; Russian spelling «Штиль». No third spelling.
- Platforms: Android 6.0+ (phones, tablets, TV boxes), Windows 10/11, macOS 12+.
  No iOS or Linux build of our own; the subscription link works in third-party
  sing-box clients (for example v2RayTun on iOS).
- Core: sing-box. Protocol: VLESS + Reality over TCP.
- Key delivery: a subscription link from the Telegram bot @RealityVPNBot_bot, or a
  short pairing code (shown as a QR image for TV boxes). Any other provider's VLESS
  link works too — the app is the entrance to a tunnel, the server is not included.
- Guest access: 2 hours without Telegram, straight from the app.
- Price: 30 days free, then 499 RUB per month (also payable in Telegram Stars).
- Device limit: two devices at the same time per key.
- Interface languages: Russian, English, German, Spanish, Persian.
- No accounts inside the app, no ads, no in-app purchases.
- Updates: the app checks for a new version itself; desktop installs only builds
  carrying our signature. No app store is involved.
- Publisher certificate: none. Windows shows “Windows protected your PC” and macOS
  refuses the first launch; both are one-time confirmations documented in the README.
- Download addresses are permanent — the file behind a link is replaced, the link is not.
